entities.name: TBDMS-protected alcohol
observations: Reactant contains a side-chain C–C–O–Si(t-Bu)(Me)2 tert-butyldimethylsilyl ether.

entities.name: 2-hydroxyethyl product
observations: Product is the corresponding 2-hydroxyethyl compound formed by replacing the TBDMS substituent with hydrogen on oxygen.
The ethyl ester, thiophene ring, methyl substituent, and cyclic urea/lactam functionality remain unchanged.

entities.name: TBDMS ether deprotection
observations: The key connectivity change is cleavage of the substrate O–Si bond with formation of the free alcohol; no new heavy-atom bond is formed.
This is selective TBDMS desilylation rather than scaffold rearrangement.

entities.name: Acetic acid desilylation
observations: The exact database precedent uses acetic acid, CC(=O)O, with the TBDMS-protected substrate to give the desilylated alcohol.
Compatible alternatives include aqueous or alcoholic AcOH, dilute HCl, TBAF in THF, and HF-pyridine; only AcOH is directly supported by the exact precedent.
